summary: Gives the pip commands for CredSSP extras and explains that CredSSP wraps auth in TLS using a Windows-generated self-signed certificate that isn't validated; a different certificate can be set via the WinRM service CertificateThumbprint.
questions: How do I install CredSSP support with pip for Ansible?
Is the CredSSP certificate validated by Ansible?
How do I change the certificate CredSSP uses on Windows?

answer_card.title: CredSSP pip install and certificate
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
pip3 install "pypsrp[credssp]<=1.0.0"   # psrp
pip3 install "pywinrm[credssp]>=0.4.0"  # winrm
```

CredSSP wraps auth tokens and messages in TLS using a self-signed cert Windows generates. The HTTPS listener cert is still validated, but the **CredSSP cert is not**. To use another cert:

```powershell
Set-Item -Path WSMan:\localhost\Service\CertificateThumbprint -Value $thumbprint
```
